{"content":"import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize
from itertools import combinations

nodes=['A','B','N1','N10','N2','N3','N4','N5','N6','N7','N8','N9']
idx={n:i for i,n in enumerate(nodes)}
raw=[('A','B',41.642),('A','N10',37.964),('A','N2',26.435),('A','N3',29.233),('A','N7',34.53),('A','N8',36.461),('B','N3',27.086),('B','N7',26.13),('B','N9',9.397),('N1','N3',35.413),('N1','N4',32.489),('N1','N7',18.596),('N1','N8',19.099),('N10','N3',34.111),('N10','N4',29.728),('N10','N8',17.215),('N2','N3',9.088),('N2','N4',29.553),('N2','N5',49.062),('N2','N6',28.129),('N2','N7',33.749),('N2','N8',33.051),('N3','N5',52.892),('N3','N7',30.273),('N4','N6',14.441),('N5','N7',61.435),('N5','N9',63.885),('N6','N8',21.494),('N7','N9',21.322),('N8','N9',14.441)]
meas=[(idx[a],idx[b],r) for a,b,r in raw]
target=np.array([x[2] for x in meas])
all_edges=list(combinations(range(len(nodes)),2))
vals=np.array([10,11,12,14,15,17,19,21,23,25,28,31,35,38,42,47,52,58,64,71,79,88,97,108,119,132,147,163,180,200],float)

def calc(edges,g,grad=False):
    n=len(nodes); ref=n-1
    L=np.zeros((n,n))
    for (u,v),c in zip(edges,g):
        L[u,u]+=c; L[v,v]+=c; L[u,v]-=c; L[v,u]-=c
    try: K=np.linalg.inv(L[:ref,:ref])
    except np.linalg.LinAlgError: return (np.full(len(meas),1e6),None) if grad else np.full(len(meas),1e6)
    rs=[]; qs=[]; xs=[]
    for a,b,_ in meas:
        q=np.zeros(ref)
        if a<ref:q[a]+=1
        if b<ref:q[b]-=1
        x=K@q
        rs.append(q@x); qs.append(q); xs.append(x)
    rs=np.array(rs)
    if not grad:return rs
    J=np.empty((len(meas),len(edges)))
    for j,(u,v) in enumerate(edges):
        for k,x in enumerate(xs):
            z=(x[u] if u<ref else 0)-(x[v] if v<ref else 0)
            J[k,j]=-z*z
    return rs,J

def fit(edges,x0=None,maxiter=500,lam=0):
    m=len(edges)
    if x0 is None:x0=np.full(m,1/50)
    def fg(g):
        r,J=calc(edges,g,True); e=r-target
        f=np.mean(e*e)+lam*np.sum(np.sqrt(g*g+1e-10))
        gr=2*J.T@e/len(e)+lam*g/np.sqrt(g*g+1e-10)
        return f,gr
    out=minimize(fg,x0,jac=True,method='L-BFGS-B',bounds=[(1/500,1/5)]*m,options={'maxiter':maxiter,'ftol':1e-14,'gtol':1e-10,'maxls':50})
    err=calc(edges,out.x)-target
    return out.x,float(np.sqrt(np.mean(err*err))),float(np.max(np.abs(err)))

def prune(seed=0):
    rng=np.random.default_rng(seed)
    edges=all_edges.copy()
    g0=rng.uniform(1/150,1/25,len(edges))
    g,rms,mx=fit(edges,g0,800,lam=1e-6)
    print('start',rms,mx,flush=True)
    while len(edges)>20:
        order=np.argsort(g)[:min(10,len(edges)-19)]
        best=None
        for j in order:
            ee=edges[:j]+edges[j+1:]
            gg=np.delete(g,j)
            ng,nr,nm=fit(ee,gg,250,lam=2e-7)
            score=nr
            if best is None or score<best[0]:best=(score,nm,ee,ng,edges[j])
        rms,mx,edges,g,_removed=best
        if len(edges)%5==0 or len(edges)<=25: print('n',len(edges),'rms',rms,'max',mx,'removed',tuple(nodes[x] for x in _removed),flush=True)
    g,rms,mx=fit(edges,g,1200,lam=0)
    return edges,g,rms,mx

def swap_refine(edges,g,rounds=5):
    for rr in range(rounds):
        base_r=np.sqrt(np.mean((calc(edges,g)-target)**2)); best=(base_r,None)
        absent=[e for e in all_edges if e not in edges]
        # prioritize removals with least conductance and additions incident to measured-short pairs, but scan all
        for j in range(20):
            for add in absent:
                ee=edges.copy(); ee[j]=add
                if len(set(ee))<20:continue
                x0=g.copy(); x0[j]=1/50
                ng,nr,nm=fit(ee,x0,180,lam=0)
                if nr<best[0]-1e-7:best=(nr,(ee,ng,nm,edges[j],add))
        if best[1] is None:break
        edges,g,mx,rem,add=best[1]
        print('swap',rr,best[0],mx,tuple(nodes[x] for x in rem),'->',tuple(nodes[x] for x in add),flush=True)
    return edges,g

def discrete_cd(edges,g,cycles=100):
    ridx=np.array([np.argmin(abs(vals-1/x)) for x in g])
    def obj(ii):
        e=calc(edges,1/vals[ii])-target
        return np.max(np.abs(e)),np.mean(e*e)
    best=obj(ridx)
    print('snap',best,flush=True)
    for cyc in range(cycles):
        changed=False
        order=np.argsort(np.random.default_rng(cyc).random(20))
        for j in order:
            old=ridx[j]; local=(best,old)
            for k in range(len(vals)):
                ridx[j]=k; o=obj(ridx)
                if (o[1],o[0]) < (local[0][1],local[0][0]):local=(o,k)
            ridx[j]=local[1]
            if local[1]!=old:changed=True;best=local[0]
        print('cd',cyc,best,flush=True)
        if not changed:break
    return ridx,best

bestall=None
for seed in range(6):
    edges,g,rms,mx=prune(seed)
    print('SEED',seed,'continuous',rms,mx,[(nodes[u],nodes[v],round(1/x,2)) for (u,v),x in zip(edges,g)],flush=True)
    edges,g=swap_refine(edges,g,3)
    ri,o=discrete_cd(edges,g)
    print('RESULT',seed,o,[(nodes[u],nodes[v],int(vals[k])) for (u,v),k in zip(edges,ri)],flush=True)
    if bestall is None or (o[1],o[0])<(bestall[0][1],bestall[0][0]):bestall=(o,edges.copy(),ri.copy())
    if o[0]<0.000500001:break
print('BEST',bestall[0],[(nodes[u],nodes[v],int(vals[k])) for (u,v),k in zip(bestall[1],bestall[2])],flush=True)
